title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first part with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.375, 0.375) with a radius of 0.375. Draw the second loop as a circle with the same center but a radius of 0.3618. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are zero, no additional transformation is needed. Extrude the sketch 0.0066 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The dimensions of this part are 0.7499999999999998 units in length, 0.7499999999999998 units in width, and 0.006578947368421051 units in height.

For the second part, create another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.0, 0.0, 0.0066). On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.375, 0.375) with a radius of 0.375. Draw the second loop as a circle with the same center but a radius of 0.3717. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Again, no transformation is needed due to the Euler angles and translation vector being zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0132 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction and add this extrusion to the existing body. The dimensions of this part are 0.7499999999999998 units in length, 0.7499999999999998 units in width, and 0.013157894736842103 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.375, 0.375)
    .circle(0.375)
    .circle(0.3618)
    .extrude(0.0066)
)

# Part 2
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.375, 0.375)
    .circle(0.375)
    .circle(0.3717)
    .extrude(0.0132)
    .translate((0, 0, 0.0066))
)

# Combine parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

# Create the outer circle

inner_r = 0.360

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_r)
    .circle(inner_r)
